messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Telugu, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Telugu line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.
నేను జూలియో కాలంలో జన్మించాను, ఆలస్యంగా అయినప్పటికీ, నేను రోమాలో మంచి ఆగస్టస్ పాలనలో జీవించాను అసత్యమైన మరియు అబద్ధపు దేవతల కాలంలో.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Word Mapping Table (Source → Telugu)**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Word / Phrase | Back‑Translation (Eng.) | Status | |-------------|----------------------|----------------------|--------------------------|--------| | Nacqui | “I was born” (1st sg perf.) | **జన్మించాను** | “was born” | OK | | sub | preposition “under / in the time of” | **కాలంలో** | “in the time of” | OK | | Iulio | proper name “Julio” | **జూలియో** | “Julio” | OK | | ancor | concessive adverb “though / even though” | **అయినప్పటికీ** | “though” | OK | | che | subordinator “that” (introduces subjunctive) | **అయినప్పటికీ** (embedded) | “that” (concessive) | OK | | fosse | subjunctive “was” (state of lateness) | **అయినప్పటికీ** (embedded) | “was” (concessive) | OK | | tardi | adjective “late” (adverbially) | **ఆలస్యంగా** | “late” | OK | | e (line 71) | coordinating conjunction “and” | — (omitted) | — | **UNNECESSARY** (conjunction dropped in Telugu) | | vissi | “I lived” (1st sg perf.) | **జీవించాను** | “lived” | OK | | a | preposition “at / in” (locative) | **రోమాలో** (locative suffix) | “in” | OK | | Roma | proper name “Rome” | **రోమా** (root of **రోమాలో**) | “Rome” | OK | | sotto | preposition “under” (political authority) | **పాలనలో** | “under the rule” | OK | | ’l | definite article “the” | — (omitted) | — | **UNNECESSARY** (articles not used in Telugu) | | buono | adjective “good” | **మంచి** | “good” | OK | | Augusto | proper name “Augustus” | **ఆగస్టస్** | “Augustus” | OK | | nel | contraction “in the” | **కాలంలో** (same as “sub”) | “in the” | OK | | tempo | noun “time” | **కాలంలో** | “time” | OK | | de | preposition “of” (genitive) | **దేవతల** (genitive suffix) | “of” | OK | | li | definite article “the” (plural) | — (omitted) | — | **UNNECESSARY** | | dèi | noun “gods” (plural) | **దేవతల** | “gods” | OK | | falsi | adjective “false” | **అసత్యమైన** | “false” | OK | | e (line 72) | coordinating conjunction “and” | **మరియు** | “and” | OK | | bugiardi | adjective “lying” | **అబద్ధపు** | “lying” | OK |
### Items Requiring Attention - **UNNECESSARY**: `e` (line 71), `’l`, `li` – Telugu naturally omits these conjunctions/articles. - No **MISSING**, **WRONG**, or **GRAMMAR** issues were detected; all required meanings are present and grammatically correct in the Telugu rendering.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Telugu script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Telugu text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- Line 70: - Original: నేను జూలియో కాలంలో జన్మించాను, ఆలస్యంగా అయినప్పటికీ, - Issue: none - Corrected: నేను జూలియో కాలంలో జన్మించాను, ఆలస్యంగా అయినప్పటికీ, - Line 71: - Original: నేను రోమాలో మంచి ఆగస్టస్ పాలనలో జీవించాను - Issue: none - Corrected: నేను రోమాలో మంచి ఆగస్టస్ పాలనలో జీవించాను - Line 72: - Original: అసత్యమైన మరియు అబద్ధపు దేవతల కాలంలో. - Issue: none - Corrected: అసత్యమైన మరియు అబద్ధపు దేవతల కాలంలో.
